rationale: Vehicle braking behavior is itself what must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking, as established by SG-3 and H-3's sudden-stop event without an obstacle ahead. The declared operational scope matches H-3. P does not expand the phenomenon to include sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing merely because these may influence braking.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” identifies the behavior directly addressed by the evaluation target, rather than an ancillary control or observation mechanism.
“Straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h in good weather” reproduces the hazard's operational conditions.
“No visible obstacles or vehicles in front of the ego vehicle” is explicitly supported by the hazard's operational situation.
The declared scope remains confined to the hazard-described operational situations and introduces no additional mechanisms or timing constraints.
